channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Minnesota sues Texas governor over ICE agent extradition
item.description: ICE agent Christian Castro faces charges of second-degree assault and false reporting, filed in May.

item.title: Skydiving couple exchanges vows midair
item.description: Professional skydivers Mike Missroon and Megan Walsh began their wedding ceremony by jumping with their bridal party.

item.title: ZZ Top drummer Frank Beard dies at 77
item.description: The band was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2004.

item.title: Trump: No talks with Iran ongoing or scheduled
item.description: President Trump says the U.S. is not in talks with Iran amid tensions over the Strait of Hormuz.
